observations: No new photos were provided after the seller’s reply.
The only visible item remains a Honda/Acura-labeled panel/trim piece in photo 0; no engine or suspension components are shown.

claims.claim: Engine, suspension and body parts for all model of acura and honda cars and suvs
claims.evidence: No engine/suspension/body parts are visible in photo 0; only a panel/trim piece is shown.
No import documents, labels, or markings indicating Belgium are visible in photo 0.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: Seller asserts testing, but there is no engine/suspension photo or video, no diagnostic scan, and no odometer/engine code evidence.

risks.risk: Mismatch risk: the seller’s claimed engine/suspension set may not be what’s actually being sold (photo shows only a trim/panel).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo set of the exact engine and/or suspension components being sold (engine block, mounts, suspension arms/struts) and a photo showing the full items together.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not the claimed engine/suspension (worst case: treat as only the visible trim/panel).

risks.risk: Condition risk: 'no knock' and 'working' can’t be verified without test evidence.
risks.proof: Request a short video of cold start + running sound (no knock) and/or a diagnostic scan screenshot showing no major faults.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown/assume not proven (worst case: not working/needs inspection).

risks.risk: Fitment risk across 'all models' of Acura/Honda SUVs: wrong engine variant/year can make parts unusable.
risks.proof: Request part numbers and fitment list (make/model/year/engine) plus close-up of stamped/label part number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as uncertain fit (worst case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Origin risk: 'tokunbo direct from Belgium' can’t be confirmed without documents/labels.
risks.proof: Request import documents/receipt or clear photos of any labels/markings tied to Belgium shipment.
risks.if_unproven: Price without any tokunbo premium (worst case: treated as ordinary used/unknown origin).

proof_requests: Send new photos of the actual engine and/or suspension parts being sold (not just the panel/trim), including close-ups of engine block and suspension mounting areas.
Provide part numbers and fitment (make/model/year/engine variant) with photos of the stamped/label numbers.
Send a video proof: engine cold start + running sound (no knock) and/or suspension movement/inspection.
Send diagnostic scan screenshot (if available) and any import documents/labels for Belgium origin.
response.reason: The seller’s text assertion isn’t supported by the only provided photo, which shows a Honda/Acura-labeled panel/trim piece rather than the claimed engine/suspension parts. Without new photos or test/diagnostic evidence, pricing would be unreliable.
